title: ❌ AI Art vs. Human Art: The Story Makes the Difference (Adsy Talks ep. 11)
description:
If you're using AI and you think that's art – it's not. It's not the same thing. 

Art is fundamentally human. It's about life, history, experience, and stories. The thing that makes art art is that a human being lived something and found a way to make you feel it too. 

AI has never lived anything, so it can only imitate the shape of all of those things, but imitation and creation are not the same thing. 

Want to learn more about SEO in the AI era, why solely traffic is a bad goal, and why great content is no longer enough? Then watch a full episode with Rand Fishkin, co-founder of Moz and Sparkoro and one of the most respected industry experts.

#adsytalks #adsy #RandFishkin #ai #aiart #creativity #humancreativity #artificialintelligence #storytelling #contentmarketing #digitalmarketing #brandstrategy #artvsai
